title: Build a Voice Assistant Pipeline — The Phase 6 Capstone

questions.question: How many samples are in one mic_generator chunk with sr=16000 and chunk_ms=20?
What does the 15-chunk pre-roll retain before speech triggers?
options: Up to 300 ms of recent audio
questions.explanation: The buffer holds at most 15 chunks, each 20 ms, so it preserves up to 300 ms before the first active chunk.

questions.question: What transcript does streaming_stt return for the captured utterance?
options: set a timer for five minutes
An empty string until TTS starts
questions.explanation: This pedagogical stub returns that fixed transcript after a duration-dependent sleep.

questions.question: Which tool call does llm_with_tools produce for that transcript?
options: No tool call; only free-form text
questions.explanation: The transcript contains timer, so the stub creates a set_timer call with seconds=300.

questions.question: What does dispatch_tool return for an unknown tool name?
options: It raises before inspecting the name
questions.explanation: Only set_timer enters the success branch; all other names return the false result.

questions.question: Why does streaming_tts return a list of chunks rather than one long waveform?
options: It ensures every audio chunk has the same speaker
It changes the reply into a database query
It removes the need to split text into words
It exposes incremental playback so the caller can begin speaking before the whole reply is rendered
questions.explanation: The stub makes one placeholder chunk per word and play consumes them sequentially, illustrating streaming output.
